::: {#exm-forward-marginal}

#### Noising the eruptions

::: {#fig-forward-process}

```{python}
#| fig-alt: "Four scatter plots of the standardized eruptions after 0, 10, 50 and 100 steps of added noise. The two clusters are clear at step 0, blurred at step 10, and gone by step 50; at step 100 the points form one round cloud centred at 0."
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(12, 3), sharex=True, sharey=True)
noise = torch.randn(standardized.shape, generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(5))
for ax, t in zip(axes, [0, 10, 50, 100]):
    alpha_bar = 1.0 if t == 0 else alpha_bars[t - 1].item()
    noised = math.sqrt(alpha_bar) * standardized + math.sqrt(1 - alpha_bar) * noise
    ax.scatter(noised[:, 0], noised[:, 1], s=4);
    ax.set_title(f"step {t}");
fig.tight_layout();
plt.show()
```

The standardized eruptions after $t$ steps of a [forward diffusion process](#def-forward-process),
with the noise schedule of @exm-forward-process.

:::

@fig-forward-process draws each step at once from @thm-forward-marginal,
without computing the steps before it.
By step `r py$n_steps`,
$\vx_T$ is close to a draw from $\dNf{\vzero, \idmat}$.

:::
